description: ansible-devkit's shared Renovate policy for every repository built on it: one PR per ecosystem, patch and digest bumps automerged once the required checks (ci / gate, disclose / gate) are green, everything else reviewed. Extend it as github>Richard-Lynch/ansible-devkit//renovate/default and add only repo-specific rules.

customManagers.description: galaxy.yml `dependencies:` (a mapping of collection: range). The ansible-galaxy manager reads requirements.yml lists; this reads the mapping a collection publishes.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, every third-party action pinned to a commit digest with its tag in a comment (DEP-04).
devkit's own reusable workflows stay on release TAGS (devkit conform CONFORM-04; the tag rulesets make them immutable), grouped on their own so a devkit release is one PR.
Collection dependencies are RANGES in a library (DEP-05): widen the range, never pin it.
Patch and digest updates merge themselves once the required checks pass; minor and major wait for a human.
A major bump is opened only from the dependency dashboard.
